title: Use fresh-product structure to control the uncertain passive generator
statement: For J=i(b^dagger a-a^dagger b), fresh thermal independence gives ||J psi_in||^2=(2n+1)<N_a>+n. The declared sine commutator and invariant first-mean region bound the actual J row throughout a contact, allowing complete Duhamel parameter comparison without requiring <N_a^2><infinity.
